channel.description: Latest articles from The Kyiv Independent (kyivindependent.com)

item.title: Russia says it's ready for Zelensky-Putin meeting — but only if Ukraine's president travels to Moscow
item.description: Kremlin aide Yuri Ushakov said Moscow is prepared to ensure President Volodymyr Zelensky's security.

item.title: Syrian president arrives in Moscow for talks with Putin
item.description: The Kremlin has sought to strengthen ties with the new leadership in Damascus after the toppling of Syrian dictator Bashar al-Assad, a Russian ally, in 2024.

item.title: Ukrainian Railways introduces additional security measures after deadly Russian attack on passenger train in Kharkiv Oblast
item.description: Three Russian Geran-2 drones struck the train on Jan. 27 at around 4:30 p.m. local time in the Barvinkove community.

item.title: 'Impossible to ban grief' — how Russia tries and fails to hide its casualties in Ukraine
item.description: Russia has tightened control over information about its battlefield losses in Ukraine, cutting off data and closing one public loophole after another. item.title: Kyiv hoping to convince IMF to delay key condition for $8.1 billion loan
item.description: Kyiv is pushing to delay a new tax on self-employed entrepreneurs until after the war has ended, as well as raise the threshold at which entrepreneurs would start paying the levy, a person in the Ukrainian government familiar with the talks told the Kyiv Independent.

item.title: Why Colombian volunteers are joining war in Ukraine
item.description: Colombians, many shaped by decades of armed conflict at home, have become one of the largest groups of foreign volunteers fighting for Ukraine since the beginning of Russia's full-scale invasion in 2022. The Kyiv Independent's Jared Goyette speaks with a Colombian volunteer who spent two years fighting in Ukraine.

item.description: Just over 30 kilometers (18 miles) from Kyiv, the Gostomel animal shelter in Hostomel, Kyiv Oblast is trying to keep more than 700 cats and dogs alive and warm as Russia's attacks on Ukraine's energy infrastructure leave the country facing rolling outages, scarce heat, and long

item.title: Ukraine war latest: SBU releases greatest hits video of 2025 drone strikes on Russian aircraft
item.description: Live coverage of Russia’s war against Ukraine with breaking news and frontline updates, updated 8 times today. Ukraine's Security Service (SBU) on Jan. 28 released a video compilation of what it claimed was the destruction of more than $1 billion worth of Russian military aircraft in long-range drone strikes conducted by its Alpha special forces unit.

item.title: Exclusive: Trump's top envoy negotiating Ukraine's fate displays 'shocking' lack of knowledge about war, politics

item.title: Casualties, damage to infrastructure reported as Russia launches missiles, drones at various regions of Ukraine
item.description: Russian forces launched missile and drone attacks on several Ukrainian regions, including Kyiv and surrounding areas, overnight on Jan. 28, local authorities reported.
